sloka: रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया ।कृता मम महाप्रीतिः प्राप्तं धर्मफलं च ते ।। ६.१२२.२८ ।।
transliteration: rāmaṁ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā ।kṛtā mama mahāprītiḥ prāptaṁ dharmaphalaṁ ca te ।। 6.122.28 ।।

translations.english: "You have served with devotion to Rama and Sita and made me very happy. By this task you have earned the merit of righteousness."
